app.notes:
- Closed to the notification area, the app no longer keeps a processor core busy. It also keeps working there now: sounds, events and plugins carry on while the window is away.
- Change a client's description (yours or, with the permission, someone else's) from the right-click menu.
- A picture a plugin opens shows in that plugin's own window when it has one.
- Dialogs, the file browser and the permissions window put the cursor in their first text field when they open.
- Paused animations in plugin panels play under the mouse, like pictures in chat.
- Persian and Arabic names read the right way round in dialogs.
- Discord: each channel shows its own member list (also forums and threads), and the list comes back after a reconnect.

packages.name: Classic TS3
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.description: The light grey and blue look of the original TeamSpeak 3 client: white channel tree, black text, blue selection and talk lights, plus a Dark Classic TS3 variant of the same window.

packages.name: Direct files
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Send files of any size directly, end-to-end encrypted
packages.description: Send files of any size straight to other TeamSpeak Desktop users, end-to-end encrypted, without the server's upload limits or permissions.

packages.name: Discord
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Discord servers, voice and chat, without the Discord app
packages.description: Your Discord servers, voice and chat docked beside the bookmarks, without the Discord app: voice channels and DM calls (end-to-end encrypted), camera and Go Live, messages with emoji, GIFs, reactions, replies, files and threads, slash commands and bot DMs, plus statuses, profiles and unread mentions. Optional proxy where Discord is blocked. Log in with a QR code from the Discord phone app, your password (2FA supported) or a token; the login stays encrypted on this PC and the app talks to nobody but Discord. Discord doesn't officially allow third-party clients, so use it at your own risk.

packages.name: Highlights
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Mentions, keyword alerts and talk time
packages.description: Never miss your name: chat messages that mention you or a word you watch, and pokes, are collected in one list with a notification. Also shows who talked how long since you opened the app.

packages.name: Ludo
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Ludo for 2-4 players on your server
packages.description: Play Ludo with up to three other TeamSpeak Desktop users. Invite people from your servers, wait until everyone is connected, then roll. Moves go straight between you, end-to-end encrypted (through the TeamSpeak server only when no direct route exists).
packages.changelog:
## 1.2.0
- Pieces walk square by square to where they move
- A captured piece waits for the capturer to land, then pops back into its yard
- The die shakes while it rolls and drops in when it stops
- The winner's pieces dance

packages.name: Polls
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.description: Ask the people on your server a question and watch the answers come in live. Everyone who runs Polls gets it in their panel and votes with a click; one vote per person, changeable until you close the poll. Sent straight between you, end-to-end encrypted (through the TeamSpeak server only when no direct route exists).

packages.name: Private chat
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.description: Chat with other TeamSpeak Desktop users straight between you, end-to-end encrypted: the TeamSpeak server never sees the messages (unless no direct route exists, then they go through it, marked as such).

packages.name: Screen Share
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Share your screen or camera with your channel
packages.description: Share your screen and its sound, or your camera, and watch others', in the info panel: you join the room of your TeamSpeak channel (same name and password) through an OmeGa Meet server.

packages.name: Soundboard
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.description: Play sounds to your channel with a click or a hotkey, from a window that stays on top. Import many files at once or play one from a web address.

packages.name: Watch together
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Watch videos with your channel, in sync
packages.description: Watch a video with your channel, in step: share a web address (MP4, MKV, WebM, HLS) and everyone who joins plays it at the same moment, pausing and seeking together. Each viewer picks their own audio track and subtitles; subtitle files can be shared too. Plays in the app (ffmpeg) or in VLC.

packages.name: XO
packages.author: TeamSpeak Desktop examples
packages.summary: Tic-tac-toe with people on your server
packages.description: Play tic-tac-toe (XO) with other TeamSpeak Desktop users. Moves go straight between you, end-to-end encrypted (through the TeamSpeak server only when no direct route exists).
